title: Look: See What Really Matters
coreMove: Stop recording every input and look for the quiet pattern that explains what is really happening.
sourcePressure: The chapter turns protected space into disciplined scanning: filter for the fascinating, journal selectively, and find patterns instead of drowning in facts and opinions.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would tell the reader to pay more attention to details without teaching signal selection.

make a list of priorities without a trade-off

exampleSpecs.domain: avalanche forecaster reading a morning field board after three storms
exampleSpecs.audience: forecaster distinguishing signal from dramatic reports
exampleSpecs.stakes: too many observations can bury the slab pattern
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: She stops copying every note and circles the three repeated weak-layer mentions across valleys.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A field board is crowded with storm notes.

exampleSpecs.domain: beekeeper tracing why one apiary keeps losing queens
exampleSpecs.audience: beekeeper sorting anecdotes from repeated clues
exampleSpecs.stakes: random fixes waste the season if the queen-loss pattern is missed
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: He ignores the loud pesticide rumor until the hive cards show all losses follow the same shipment date.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Hive cards are clipped beside a queen cage label.

exampleSpecs.domain: regional train dispatcher reviewing near-miss reports at a rail junction
exampleSpecs.stakes: the quiet repeated timing clue matters more than dramatic blame
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: She highlights the same six-minute transfer overlap across reports and stops summarizing every complaint.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Near-miss reports are marked with six-minute overlaps.

exampleSpecs.domain: wildlife camera-trap researcher sorting thousands of night images
exampleSpecs.stakes: recording every animal equally hides the movement corridor
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Before, every image is tagged; after, he tracks only repeated crossings at the dry creek bed.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Night images spill around a dry-creek map.

exampleSpecs.domain: community theater costume lead after repeated quick-change failures
exampleSpecs.audience: lead looking past excuses to pattern
exampleSpecs.stakes: every complaint is loud, but one costume fastener is the repeated cause
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: She asks actors to stop explaining and places failed snaps beside the quick-change timing chart.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Failed snaps sit beside a quick-change chart.

exampleSpecs.domain: forensic accountant reviewing charity expense receipts after a whistleblower tip
exampleSpecs.stakes: chasing every odd receipt can miss the repeated vendor path
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: He stacks receipts by vendor and circles the one reimbursement route that repeats across departments.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Receipts are stacked by vendor on a green desk pad.
